components.name: Nav item · Web
components.description: Web navigation row. Mode: Expanded (240×40) · Collapsed (40×40) · Module (40×40, module rail) · Sub (240×32, second level, no icon). State: Default · Hover · Selected · Selected hover · Focus · Disabled. Props: Label, Badge, Chevron; swap the icon through the nested icon instance.

components.name: Nav group · Web
components.description: A titled block of web Nav items. Title + Title text, Item 1–8, ↳ Item 1–4 subs (four Sub rows, indented 32 so their labels line up under the parent label — turn on that item’s Chevron too), Divider. Title and sub lists hide in Collapsed; the layer tree is the same in both modes, so overrides survive the switch.

components.name: Module rail · Web
components.description: Web module rail: the narrow left rail that picks the module. Width hugs 40 + 2×12. Module 1–8 + Bottom item use Nav item Mode=Module (selected = solid accent). Labels shows every module name in a chip 8 px to the right (hover state); each chip lives inside its module, so hiding a module hides its name. Height is fixed in the component — set it to Fill in a layout; the bottom item stays pinned.

components.name: Menu panel · Web
components.description: Web menu panel: the pages of the selected module. Mode: Expanded 256 · Collapsed 56 (40 item + 2×8). Top (Search) hugs, Middle fills and clips, Bottom (Collapse button) hugs and stays pinned. Props: Search, Group 1–3, Collapse button, Flyout + ↳ Flyout title. Flyout is the collapsed-mode sub-menu: a floating panel 8 px to the right of the rail (surface/overlay, radius/surface/md, Elevation/3 Float

components.name: Header · Web
components.description: Web top bar. Height = layout/header/height (64 on Web), width fills the screen. Logo · Language · Theme · Notifications (+ count) · Profile (avatar, name, role) · Log out. Separate the header from the page by surface colour, not a border.

components.name: App shell · Web
components.description: Web app shell (1024 px and up): Header + Module rail + Menu panel + Content. Menu: Expanded / Collapsed. Place it, resize it to the screen (default 1440 × 900), put the page inside Content. Body stacks first-on-top so the collapsed flyout paints above Content.

components.name: Rail item · Tablet
components.description: Tablet rail item: one module. 56 × 32 pill indicator (size/nav-rail/indicator-w/h) with a 24 icon, label (Label/S) underneath, always visible. Selected = solid accent pill, same language as the web module rail. State: Default · Pressed · Selected · Focus · Disabled. Props: Label, Icon, Badge (count on the pill).

components.name: Nav rail · Tablet
components.description: Tablet navigation rail: modules, always visible, labels always on. Width size/nav-rail/width (72). Item 1–6 + Bottom item (pinned). Use up to 6 modules; move the rest to the drawer. Height is fixed in the component — set it to Fill in a layout.

components.name: Nav item · Touch
components.description: Touch navigation row for drawers on tablet and mobile. Mode: Item (48 tall, size/nav-item; 24 icon; Label/L) · Sub (44 tall, size/touch-target/min; no icon; Body/M; indent 40 from the container so its label lines up under the parent label). State: Default · Pressed · Selected · Focus · Disabled. Width fills the drawer. Props: Label, Icon, Badge, Chevron.

components.name: Nav drawer
components.description: Navigation drawer for tablet and mobile: the pages of the selected module. Width layout/drawer/width (Tablet 360 · Mobile 304 = smallest phone 360 − 56 so the scrim stays tappable). Header height = layout/header/height. Body scrolls; Footer (profile, Settings, Log out) stays pinned. Props: Group 1–2, Footer, ↳ Name, ↳ Role. Opens from the menu button over a color/background/overlay scrim; closes o

components.name: Header · Tablet
components.description: Tablet top bar. Height layout/header/height (64 on Tablet). Menu button (opens the Nav drawer) · Logo · Search · Notifications (+ count) · Avatar. Language, theme, name, role and Log out live in the drawer footer or settings.

components.name: App shell · Tablet
components.description: Tablet app shell (600–1023 px), 834 × 1194: Header + Nav rail + Content. Drawer: Closed / Open — the drawer and a color/background/overlay scrim cover everything, including the header. Content padding layout/page-margin (24 on Tablet).

components.name: App shell · Mobile
components.description: Mobile app shell (360–599 px), 390 × 844: Top bar + Content + Bottom nav. Drawer: Closed / Open — drawer (304) and scrim cover the whole screen, bars included. Content padding layout/page-margin (16 on Mobile).

6.2 Navigation.text:
NAVIGATION
BEK
Design System
6.2 Navigation
How people move between modules and pages, standardised for three devices. Web (1024 px and up) uses two rails and a header. Tablet (600–1023) uses a rail of modules and an overlay drawer. Mobile (360–599) uses a top bar, a bottom navigation bar and a drawer. The model stays the same everywhere: modules first, then the pages of the selected module.
Devices
One navigation model, three shapes. Pick the section for the device you design for.
